description.value: Aroy Thai Kitchen is a family-owned Thai restaurant situated in Rocky Point Centre in Port Moody, where 'aroy' means 'delicious' in Thai. The kitchen prides itself on fresh, locally sourced vegetables picked daily and house-made sauces, dressings, and hand-rolled spring rolls prepared from scratch each day. Touring cyclists will find a full sit-down restaurant offering both dine-in and takeout, with delivery available through Skip The Dishes and DoorDash.

address.value: 1-2816 St Johns Street, Port Moody, BC V3H 2C1

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: staple at 93m; staple at 98m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a real, operating Thai restaurant at 1-2816 St Johns Street in Port Moody. Phone number (604) 949-1811 matches OSM exactly. The website has a dedicated Take Out page and a Delivery page listing Skip The Dishes and Door Dash, confirming takeout availability. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist amenities anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' but the restaurant is located in Port Moody, BC — a separate municipality. The website's About and Contact pages both confirm Port Moody.
OSM address omits the unit number prefix '1-' that appears on the website contact page (1-2816 St Johns Street). Address has been corrected to match the website.
Website copyright reads '© 2019 All Rights Reserved', suggesting it may not have been updated recently, though the business does not appear to be closed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating Thai restaurant with confirmed website and phone. Takeout availability makes it useful to touring cyclists.
